sentences: Traders moved $683 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-11-02, across 17.0 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 50% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 50%.
The most-traded market was "Will the Democratic Party control the House after the 2026 Midterm elections?", pulling in $9 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
Both sides made money this week. Bots collected $677 (+29 bps); retail collected $117 (+105 bps).
